content: Professional swing trading scanners display industry/sector momentum via: (1) RS Rating 1-99 percentile vs all stocks (IBD standard); (2) Industry group rank 1-197, with rank change vs 3 and 6 months ago showing trend; (3) RS Line overlay (stock vs S&P 500 as proxy); (4) Sector Momentum Score with rank (1=strongest); (5) Binary modifiers: Hot Sector/Hot Industry (+5), Improving Momentum (+5), Declining Momentum (-5); (6) 15-period Ratio Trend Matrix for 15-day trend direction; (7) Price X% from 21-day EMA as distance metric. For swing trading specifically, 5/10/20-day relative performance periods matter most. IBD divides all stocks into 197 industry groups ranked by least-squares curve fit on summed prices. Minimum viable display needs: industry name, current rank, rank direction (improving/declining), and top-half vs bottom-half binary flag.
